subject: Channel Private Offer: APAC localization & tax/legal readiness for reseller launch
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@cloudresell.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Channel Private Offer: APAC localization & tax/legal readiness for reseller launch

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Per our call, CloudResell's first CPPO in APAC looks like a great pilot for a broader channel motion. To keep momentum, I've pulled together a short checklist (attached) that lists the minimal legal/tax evidence and the regional localization items we typically need before Marketplace can approve go-live.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm entity mapping for invoicing (local entity + tax IDs)
- Provide sample reseller PO flow and expected billing cadence
- Share any local distributor agreements that affect margin/tax treatment

Can you confirm who on your side will own the tax / legal packet? If you can get the mapping back by EOD Tuesday we can start coordinating with AWS for the CPPO entitlement window.

I've looped Ben and Soojin for procurement and AWS ops questions. I attached the checklist and an invoice mapping template to make it easier.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Channels, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CPPO_APAC_localization_checklist.pdf (summary), invoice-mapping-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Alicia Torres <alicia@cloudresell.co>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.co>, Maria Chen <maria@cloudresell.co>
Date: 2028-04-11T11:03:00+10:00
Subject: Re: Channel Private Offer: APAC localization & tax/legal readiness for reseller launch

Hi Vivek,

Great to kick this off. I'll own the tax/legal packet for CloudResell and will pull Maria in on the invoice mapping. A couple quick notes after a run through: 

- For Singapore and Australia we have separate tax IDs; I'll populate those into your template and return by Tue EOD Singapore time.
- We use a distributor agreement with a local partner in Japan — I'll redact commercially sensitive terms and include the relevant section that affects invoicing.
- One ask: can Redwood confirm whether you require signed reseller attestations for CPPO or if a PO + low-risk evidence bundle is sufficient?

I'll send the first pass of the mapping tomorrow morning. Looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Head of Partnerships, CloudResell
alicia@cloudresell.co

Attachment: none

Subject: RE: Channel Private Offer: APAC localization & tax/legal readiness for reseller launch

Vivek / Alicia —

Thanks — quick procurement notes from our side:

1) Entitlement & PO flow: We can support both direct PO-to-Redwood and drop-ship to CloudResell. For CPPO entitlements we need the mapping in the invoice template filled for each legal entity; the template also drives the SKU entitlement matrix.

2) Invoicing cadence: If CloudResell wants monthly consolidation vs per-entity invoicing that will change our billing setup and requires an SLA exception for consolidated billing. We can accommodate it but need the consolidated bank/AR contact info.

3) Reseller attestations: Short answer — a signed reseller attestation lowers our manual evidence bar but is not strictly required for low-dollar pilots. If CloudResell can sign the attestation it will speed the AWS approval. I attached a one-page attestation draft (see Drive link in metadata).

Sooj, any outstanding AWS ops asks before we send to AWS with CloudResell?

Cheers,
Ben
Director, Revenue Operations
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: invoice-mapping-template.xlsx (updated), aws-evidence-ask.txt

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@cloudresell.co>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Channel Private Offer: APAC localization & tax/legal readiness for reseller launch

All —

Quick ops checklist from AWS perspective (short):
- Evidence: we need a short bundle: reseller PO sample, entity tax IDs, and the attestation Ben mentioned. Put those into a single PDF named "CPPO_Evidence_Packet_{reseller}.pdf".
- SKU mapping: please complete the invoice-mapping-template.xlsx and include the SKU->entitlement row for the APAC SKUs. The template includes a comment with common pitfalls (currency vs local tax code).
- Marketplace listing locales: if you want JP/SG/AU public listing text localized we need final strings by EOD Friday to avoid a two-week review delay.

Alicia — if CloudResell can share the PO sample and the tax ID spreadsheet, Vanessa and I will stage it for AWS review and include a short runbook for entitlement provisioning.

I'll also add a short legal checklist to the Drive link so legal teams can tick boxes before submission.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
